body:
Browser Back and Forward retrace page changes today, but not Strategy tab changes or record-link activations. Make them retrace all three.

- A Strategy tab change adds a history entry for `/strategy?tab=<name>`, and Back/Forward restores that tab in the mounted page rather than only reading it on load.
- Following a `task:<id>`, `feature:<id>` or `milestone:<id>` link adds a history entry for the resulting page focus; Back/Forward restores the previous page, tab and focused record. A link that stays on the same page must add an entry too.
- Direct visits to `/task/<id>`, `/feature/<id>`, `/milestone/<id>` and `/strategy?tab=<name>` still work. Resolve a direct record link in place so it does not add a dead entry; modified clicks still keep the browser's new-tab behavior.

D-90 point 3 chose `replaceState` for tabs, so record a new human-approved decision amending it before changing that behavior.

**Tests:** tab changes and Back/Forward restore the tab and model; record-link activation and Back/Forward restore page and focus; same-page links; direct-URL in-place resolution; modified clicks are untouched.
title: nav: Back follows tabs and links
